answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The pulse cap is upheld at intake and thread shows the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a mesa tag. That is 37 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
